presets.name: Walnut plywood 3 mm (calibrated)
presets.note: Calibrated on our Hurricane: Bambu Lab walnut ply, 1000 mm/min, 100 %, Start cutting Z step 2 mm.

presets.name: Leather 1 mm (veg-tan)
presets.note: Starting value, scaled from the walnut result. Veg-tan only; may trip Flame Detection.

presets.name: Opal white extruded acrylic 3 mm
presets.note: Best so far (round 8): 4 passes at 1200 mm/min, 85 %, Z 0-0-1-1. The app gives one Z for all passes (0 here); for 0-0-1-1 use one layer per pass, which also lets parts cool between passes. Air high, sheet on pins, round sharp corners.

presets.name: Clear extruded acrylic 3 mm
presets.note: Starting value from the opal tests: 2 passes, Start Z 2, Z step 1. Engraving extruded gives a clear-grey mark, not white frost.

presets.name: Clear extruded acrylic 6 mm
presets.note: Starting value, scaled from the walnut result, focus 3 mm down. Expect taper.

presets.name: Birch / poplar plywood 3 mm
presets.note: Same as our walnut result (poplar core); not tested on birch.

presets.name: MDF 5 mm
presets.note: AtomStack's 500 mm/min at 80 %, scaled from our walnut result. Run with Flame Detection off and stay at the machine.
